specTitle: Test Case 1: Verify homepage loads and displays the hero CTA
title: Medtronic Homepage: Verify homepage loads and hero 'See how' CTA is visible
preconditions: User navigates to Medtronic India homepage (https://www.medtronic.com/in-en/index.html)
steps:
1. Navigate to https://www.medtronic.com/in-en/index.html
2. Verify the page URL contains 'in-en/index.html'
3. Verify the page title contains 'Medtronic'
4. Verify the 'See how' CTA link is visible on the hero banner
expected: The homepage loads with correct URL and title. The 'See how' CTA link is visible on the hero banner.
